country.description: This evening and tonight: Partly cloudy.
After morning hours clouds dissipation, the weather will become clear.A rise in temperatures is expected. The sea is dangerous for swimming.

During the morning partly cloudy to cloudy, with a chance of a drizzle or a very light rain along the coastline and the coastal plain. During the day the weather will become fair.  A drop in temperatures is expected, becoming slightly below seasonal in the mountains and inland areas.
Partly cloudy to clear during the morning, becoming fair later on during the day. A slight rise in temperatures is expected ,becoming seasonal.

Partly cloudy to clear during the morning, becoming fair later on during the day. A slight rise in temperatures is expected, mainly in the mountains and inland areas, with a slight increase in heat stress indices.
